gloss: to massage thoroughly; to knead out; to loosen up

definitions.gloss: to massage thoroughly; to knead out (muscles); to loosen up
definitions.explanation: To rub and press a stiff muscle or knotted body part until the tension dissolves. Compound of {揉|も}む (to knead) + ほぐす (to loosen), implying both motions in one continuous action. Often used for shoulders, neck, and feet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{固|かた}く→固い：12090_katai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もみほぐした。
examples.english: I carefully massaged the stiffened muscles loose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦トレーナー→トレーナー：21469_toreenaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧もみほぐして⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Before the match the trainer thoroughly massaged the athlete's legs.

notes:
Transitive godan verb (もみほぐす・もみほぐして・もみほぐした). Compound of ⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧ + ⟦ほぐす→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧, common in massage and sports contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: marks the body part with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もみほぐす: to massage shoulders
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もみほぐす: to massage feet

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧・⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧・⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もみほぐす: to massage shoulders/neck/lower back
- ⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もみほぐす: to loosen the muscles
- ⟦{凝|こ}り→凝り：07279_kori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もみほぐす: to knead out stiffness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧: to knead; to rub — broader, may not imply loosening as the goal
- ⟦ほぐす→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧: to loosen; to untangle — broader; not limited to massage
- ⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to massage — generic loanword, doesn't specify kneading motion
